items.why: You own your home in Santa Ana and live in it, so you can claim it. Many Habitat families never file.
items.worth: It takes $7,000 off your assessed value, about $70 less property tax every year.
items.nextStep: File form BOE-266 with the Orange County Assessor this week. You only file once.

items.why: Your household of 4 earns under the FERA limit of $80,400 a year, so you likely qualify for FERA.
items.worth: About $220 a year off your Southern California Edison bill.
items.nextStep: Apply on the Southern California Edison website. It takes about 5 minutes and no documents.

items.why: You're on the California FAIR Plan, which must give a discount for wildfire-safety upgrades.
items.worth: At least $71 a year off your premium, often more.
items.nextStep: Clear 5 feet around the house and screen your vents, then call the FAIR Plan and ask for the Safer from Wildfires discount.

items.why: As a Habitat homeowner you can ask for help before a repair becomes an emergency.
items.worth: Repairs at low or no cost, depending on the program and your income.
items.nextStep: Call Habitat OC and ask which home repair programs are open now.

items.why: Anyone in Orange County can call, day or night, in English or Spanish.
items.worth: Help with your mortgage, utilities or food if a big bill or a job loss hits.
items.nextStep: Save 211 in your phone, or visit 211oc.org to see what's open near you.
